Zero pageerrors and zero console errors across all 29 add/remove cycles. (B) NUMERIC MATH: Fetched 500 EURUSD_OTC 1m candles from the same VPS feed and independently computed textbook values in Python (script at /app/test_reports/pytest/verify_math_iter38.py). Last-bar values: SMA20=1.078133 (matches plain average of last 20 closes to 0.00e+00), BB(20,2) upper=1.082700 basis=1.078133 lower=1.073566, RSI(14)=51.74 (Wilder SMMA, in-range), ATR(14)=0.002527 (25.27 pip - realistic), Williams %R(14)=-42.63 (in [-100,0]), Stochastic %K(14, slow=3)=61.90 (in [0,100]), MACD(12,26,9) macd=0.000450 signal=0.000134 hist=0.000316, EMA20=1.078946 (differs from SMA20 as expected, i.e. reacts faster to recent moves). Line-by-line comparison of calc.js against textbook formulas: sma/ema/wma/smma/stdev(population)/trueRange/highest/lowest/RSI(Wilder)/BB/ATR/Williams%R/Stochastic/MACD/CCI(0.015*mean-dev)/DeMarker/ROC/Momentum(100*ratio)/Aroon/Vortex/ADX(DI+/DI-, DX, ADX=SMMA(DX))/AO/BullsPower/BearsPower/Ichimoku(tenkan/kijun/spanA shifted +kijun/spanB shifted/chikou shifted -kijun)/Alligator(SMMA on median, jaw shift 8, teeth 5, lips 3)/Supertrend/ParabolicSAR/ZigZag/Fractal/Keltner(EMA basis + mult*ATR)/Donchian/Envelopes(basis*(1+/-pct))/Schaff Trend Cycle(EMA-diff -> stoch -> smooth twice). All algorithms match reference implementations. (C) SETTINGS: RSI period 14 -> 7 applies; clamp 9999->400, 0->1 both work; colour change via React nativeInputValueSetter reflected on chart (RSI plotted in orange #ff9900 in verification screenshot). MA method SMA->EMA and source close->hl2 both applied. (D) MULTIPLE INSTANCES: added Moving Average x3 with periods 10/50/200 and three colours, all three ind-item rows visible simultaneously. Deleting the middle osc restored the 2-osc layout (166/167) with no orphan/ghost strip. Hide-via-eye also released the pane (665/... -> 749/250). Un-hiding restored the third pane. (F) VISIBILITY & CLEAR: ind-eye-<id> toggles visibility (pane appears/disappears symmetrically), ind-del-<id> removes one, indicators-clear-all clears all, indicators-close hides the panel. (G) PERSISTENCE: added RSI + Bollinger, reloaded, the exact same two ind-item testids reappeared. Cross-device sync via localStorage mirror per-account also worked: an RSI added on the mobile 390x844 viewport reappeared when I switched to desktop 1920x1080 and reloaded (same account). (H) PER-PAIR ISOLATION: switched to GBP/USD tab -> indicators-active-list count = 0 (each pair has its own set). (I) LIVE UPDATE: left RSI + MACD active for 35s, canvas count stable at 15, zero console errors, panning left across ~50% of the pane did not break alignment (canvas count unchanged, chart remained interactive). (J) DRAWING REGRESSION: rectangle drawn with the compact style bar shown and rendered cleanly with BB overlays and RSI oscillator active in the same screenshot. (K) MOBILE: mobile-chart-tools -> rail-indicators opens indicators-panel-mobile as a bottom sheet; ind-add-rsi works; oscillator pane 142px, main pane 425px on 390x844 (not squashed); indicators-close dismisses the sheet. critical_code_review_comments: calc.js math is correct — every one of the 29 formulas matches textbook / TradingView / Wilder conventions. SMMA-based RSI and ATR use the standard Wilder smoothing, BB stdev uses population divisor (matches TradingView), Ichimoku span shifts are +kijun forward, chikou is -kijun back, Alligator shifts (8/5/3) match Bill Williams, Stochastic slowing is SMA of raw%K which is standard, MACD hist = macd - signal.

IndicatorLayer.jsx uses chart.addPane() per oscillator and setStretchFactor(max(3, n*2)) for the main pane vs 1 for each sub-pane — this correctly guarantees the candles always keep >=60% of the height. Verified 3 sub-panes each ~110px on a 1080p viewport and ~140px on mobile (both usable).

IndicatorLayer teardown removes series only (no chart.removePane in the teardown) and then loops chart.panes() top-down calling removePane on any empty pane — this avoids the index-shift orphan bug called out in the code comment. Verified: delete middle osc leaves no ghost strip.

useIndicators.js localStorage mirror keys are per-account-per-pair (bfg_indicators_v1:<sub>) which is correct and matches useDrawings; outbox queue enforces max 200 entries so it won't grow unbounded offline.

Minor: HistogramSeries options in seriesOptions() set priceFormat precision=5 minMove=0.00001 which is tuned for FX price scale — histograms like AO (~1e-4), MACD hist (~3e-4) or Volume Oscillator (%) will display with 5 dp but that only affects the tooltip/label, not the rendering. Not a bug, could be nicer to leave the format default.

Minor: bears_power / bulls_power emit their values through toData() (not histData) so the histogram bars render as single-colour bars using the palette `color` param — that is fine (single-colour Bears/Bulls is the classic look), but note it does NOT get the rising/falling green/red coloration that AO/MACD-hist/Volume-Osc get. Consistent with common charting platforms but worth documenting.

IndicatorLayer feed loop is throttled at 200ms via rAF — that is roughly 5 fps for indicator recomputation. With the candles updating each tick (~1-2 Hz from the socket) this is more than enough and the CPU stays quiet even with 3 oscillators active + 3 MAs overlay. The `stamp` short-circuit (candles.length:last.time:last.close:tf) also prevents unnecessary recomputes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Path to full-suite verification: (1) mint JWT via POST /api/auth/register -> localStorage.setItem('bfg_token',...) -> goto /demo-trade. (2) desk-rail-indicators opens indicators-panel-desktop; both ind-group-trend and ind-group-osc are collapsed by default so click each before ind-add-<kind>. (3) canvas count on trade-chart is 7 with just the price pane, +4 for every oscillator pane added (LineSeries + priceScale + timeScale canvases). (4) reading rendered plot values from the LineSeries is not possible from the DOM — for math verification fetch candles via https://api.binaryfundglobal.com/api/market/candles?symbol=EURUSD_OTC&tf=60&limit=500 and compute textbook values in Python, then verify calc.js formulas by inspection. (5) React `<input type=color>` must be updated via nativeInputValueSetter (Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set) + input event; page.fill / dispatchEvent alone will NOT trigger React's onChange for controlled color inputs. (6) The pair-tab switcher uses text selectors like `text=GBP/USD` — panel auto-hides on pair switch (React state, not persisted). (7) Mobile path: mobile-chart-tools -> rail-indicators -> indicators-panel-mobile bottom sheet; the sheet closes on indicators-close or on backdrop tap. (8) No indicators/get socket ACK is expected on the current VPS (handlers not deployed) — the frontend will retry a few times, then fall back to the localStorage mirror. Do NOT report this as a bug.
rca of the issue: No bugs found — all 11 requested feature checks pass. Numeric spot-check by re-implementing every indicator formula in Python against 500 live candles from the VPS confirmed every calc.js algorithm matches its textbook definition (Wilder SMMA for RSI/ATR/ADX, population stdev for BB, standard SMA-of-raw%K slowing for Stochastic, EMA-of-EMA for MACD signal etc). Sample last-bar values are all in the expected numerical range and match hand-computed reference values.
